text: The process of taking stunning landscape photographs begins with proper lighting. By carefully arranging the light sources in your scene, you can focus on the intricate details of the environment. A tripod, then, ensures that your photographs are taken in a stable manner and with consistent framing. Finally, the exposure settings allow you to control the amount of light that reaches the camera's sensor, thus capturing the perfect image. Through experimentation with different lighting techniques, you can discover what best suits your photographic style.
